children: Aon entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire USI for $17 billion in cash, subject to downward adjustments for leakage since June 30, 2026. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including regulatory approvals, with an outside date of June 1, 2027, extendable by up to two three-month periods for pending approvals. The parties are not required to complete the transaction before Oct 19, 2026. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, covenants, and termination rights.
